fixtures.claim: A selected Thing can become known-unloaded while its containment parent and an inventory/reference holder remain resident.
Reload resolves the exact declared dependency closure, not the containment region.
Exact dependency order is deterministic after graph resolution.
Missing required exact bytes fail typed and publish no partial activation.
Length or digest corruption fails before decoding or activation.
A canonical artifact for another ProjectRevisionId is incompatible.
A same-ID canonical Thing whose fields differ from the authored basis is incompatible.
A Behaviour artifact with the wrong exact behaviour revision cannot satisfy an attachment.
Behaviour IR round-trips through the bounded exact artifact profile and revalidates before use.
Unknown required artifact features fail closed before activation.
Missing descriptor graph nodes produce typed failure rather than implicit resolution.
Dependency depth is independently bounded.
Dependency descriptor count is independently bounded.
Declared aggregate and per-artifact bytes are bounded before fetch/activation.
Bounded exact declarative dependency cycles are permitted without recursive publication.
Verified immutable cache bytes permit exact offline reuse after the source disappears.
Cache eviction changes neither WorldSave bytes nor loaded/known-unloaded/tombstoned/unknown meaning.
An evicted artifact may be refetched only if the same exact descriptor verifies.
Cache capacity pressure is advisory and cannot rewrite semantic state.
Cancellation before or after acquisition leaves the old coherent runtime published.
A tombstoned Thing cannot be resurrected by later acquisition.
Tombstoning removes retained queued/timer work so stale work cannot recreate the object.
Known-unloaded and unknown references remain distinct while the target is not resident.
A loaded Thing cannot be deliberately streamed out without an exact reload catalog.
Requesting stream-in for an already loaded Thing is a no-op and performs no hidden I/O.
Competing protected AssetId revisions remain complete alternatives and cannot be field-mixed.
A complete protected asset revision may join the staged closure atomically after canonical verification.
Opaque exact data is integrity checked and inert at the streaming layer; corrupt opaque data blocks activation.
